description: Source file for debugging and logging in the FreeType project, containing macros and functions for error handling, tracing, and debug message output.

methods.name: FT_Message
methods.description: Outputs a formatted message to standard error, used for error and trace messages.

methods.name: FT_Panic
methods.description: Outputs a formatted error message and terminates the program.

methods.name: FT_Throw
methods.description: Handles error codes, currently a stub returning 0.

methods.name: FT_Trace_Get_Count
methods.description: Returns the number of trace toggle levels.

methods.name: FT_Trace_Get_Name
methods.description: Returns the name of a trace toggle given its index.

methods.name: ft_debug_init
methods.description: Initializes the debugging/tracing system based on environment variables.
